input.quote: 10.1 On expiry or termination, Customer's right to access terminated subscription Services ends after any agreed transition period. Rights in accepted Deliverables, paid-up licences, Customer Data, and materials Customer owned or licensed independently continue according to their terms.
input.rationale: Section 10 (Effect of Expiry or Termination) only ends Service access "after any agreed transition period" (with no agreed period or assistance obligation), delivers paid-for Deliverables and refunds prepaid Fees; Section 16.5 addresses return/destruction of Confidential Information but defers Customer Data to Sections 11 and 15, and neither Section 15 nor the (text-less) Sections 11 and 23 contains any export, return, format, or deletion-certification obligation. There is therefore no transition-assistance or data-return clause anywhere, failing even the fallback (90 days of assistance; export within 30 days). We insert a new Section 10.3 at the preferred position.

proposal.summary: Insert transition assistance and Customer Data return/deletion obligation in Section 10
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Section 10 covers access wind-down and Deliverables but gives us no exit help or right to get our data back, so we have added our preferred exit clause: up to six months of transition assistance at Vendor's then-current rates, return of Customer Data within 30 days in a machine-readable format, and certified deletion thereafter. We can fall back to 90 days of assistance with the same 30-day export if six months is difficult.

ops.text: On expiry or termination of this Agreement or an Order Form for any reason, Vendor shall (a) at Customer's request provide transition assistance for up to six months at Vendor's then-current rates; (b) within thirty days return all Customer Data in a standard machine-readable format; and (c) after that return, delete Customer Data from its systems and certify the deletion in writing.

mappings.element: Transition obligations apply on expiry or termination.
Vendor provides transition assistance for up to six months.
Transition assistance is charged at then-current rates.
Vendor returns Customer Data within 30 days after expiry or termination.
Customer Data is returned in a standard machine-readable format.
Vendor certifies deletion of Customer Data after its return.
